attempted_claim: Let Omega_sharp be the standard smooth Diederich-Fornaess worm in C^2 with total winding W_sharp = 6*pi, so Barrett's failure line is pi/W_sharp = 1/6. Let eta_sharp be Liu's exact Diederich-Fornaess index of Omega_sharp. Then the Bergman projection B_sharp extends to a bounded operator H^s(Omega_sharp) -> H^s(Omega_sharp) for every 0 <= s < 1/6, proved via a weighted dbar-Neumann estimate from an explicitly stated D'Angelo-form / strong-DF-index hypothesis that exceeds the Berndtsson-Charpentier DF/2 barrier.
claim_type: Sobolev-positivity lemma strictly inside the DF-Barrett gap via weighted estimates
decisive_failure: Operator-level interior boundedness (s_*=13/126) remains open: neither proved nor disproved. Barrett decides only s>=1/6 (failure side); Berndtsson-Charpentier/Harrington decide only s<1/14 (positivity side). Blockage attachesto the mandated s<b/2-type weighted/D'Angelo sufficient-condition route (needs b>=13/63>eta=1/7), interpolation route (convexity cap), and operator-transfer route (wrong operator/domain) — not to the Bergman-boundedness statement itself. No original increment claimed.
